# mxroute_verification_key (Data Source)

Obtain the account verification key before adding a domain. Create the returned TXT record under the domain using a DNS provider, wait for propagation, then create the MXroute domain. This value is account information and will be stored in Terraform state. Mock-tested alpha; runtime API behavior remains live-unverified.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mxroute_verification_key" "example" {
}
```

- `key` (String) Account verification key.

- `type` (String) DNS record type.
- `value` (String) Exact DNS content, without added quoting or normalization.
